# Bright at Home Cleaning

> Family-run, faith-driven house and commercial cleaning company serving the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, including Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Celina, Prosper, Denton, Flower Mound, Grapevine and Fort Worth. Bonded and insured, background-checked cleaners, eco-friendly products, 5.0 rating from 65+ Google reviews. Call or text 469-443-6903 or email support@brightathomecleaning.com.

## Services

- [Recurring House Cleaning](https://brightathomecleaning.com/services/recurring-house-cleaning): Weekly, biweekly or monthly cleaning with the same vetted team every visit.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://brightathomecleaning.com/services/deep-cleaning): Top-to-bottom detail clean for first visits, seasonal resets and special occasions.
- [One-Time House Cleaning](https://brightathomecleaning.com/services/one-time-house-cleaning): A single thorough clean with no contract.
- [Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning](https://brightathomecleaning.com/services/move-in-move-out-cleaning): Empty-home cleaning for renters, buyers, sellers and landlords.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://brightathomecleaning.com/services/commercial-cleaning): Offices, clinics, studios and retail spaces across DFW.
